in_marathi.name: Vyomasana
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vyomasana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vyomasana is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Vyoma' meaning 'Sky' and 'Asana' meaning 'Seat'. It is believed that this name was given to the sage Vyoma who was granted a celestial seat by the gods in the heavenly realms.
